# arin_aspa (Data Source)

Read one hosted ASPA by customer ASN from an organization's ASPA collection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
# Set ARIN_API_KEY in the environment.
data "arin_aspa" "example" {
  org_handle   = "FT-684"
  customer_asn = 64496
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `customer_asn` (Number) Customer ASN as a number.
- `org_handle` (String) ARIN organization handle.

### Read-Only

- `provider_asns` (List of Number) provider asns returned by ARIN.
